# DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition (v1.0.44) — Complete AI & Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Automated ECU & TCU calibration ecosystem for Passenger Cars (4963+ ECUs / 82 brands), Heavy-Duty 24V Trucks & Agriculture (452+ ECUs), and Marine Boats / Jet Skis / Yachts (30+ brands), backed by 24h/7 365-day live multilingual engineering support. Always process 100% virgin original ECU readouts.
